state_model.observed_state: readback from executing runtime, repository, VFS, carrier or public projection
state_model.delta: canonical difference between source_state and observed_state
state_model.successor_state: observed state after an applied repair transaction

algorithm: promote only when equality/proof gate passes

race_control.required_precondition: observed input hash must equal transaction input hash at commit time
race_control.parallelism_rule: independent resources may reconcile concurrently; writes to the same logical identity serialize
